name: report_request
description: Only for an INBOUND call, where system__call_direction is inbound. Submit the caller's complete account in their own words. Never use report_call or record_check_in for inbound calls. Follow the returned status and reply: pending/prepared means still processing, needs_clarification means ask the question and resubmit the full account, recorded means saved, needs_review means no automated action is confirmed. Never claim success after a tool error.

text.description: The caller's complete account in their own words, including any clarification already given. Preserve uncertainty and negation. For a status retry send exactly the same text.
